candidate.educational_objective: Recognize bronchial asthma as a contraindication to propranolol and clarify the prescription before administration.

options.A: Clarify the prescription because propranolol is contraindicated in bronchial asthma and requires prescriber review.
options.B: Give propranolol as ordered because nonselective beta blockade does not aggravate stable bronchial asthma.
options.C: Hold all beta-blocker therapy because any history of asthma contraindicates the entire medication class permanently.
options.D: Substitute a beta1-selective blocker without contacting the prescriber because it has no bronchospasm risk.

candidate.rationale: Propranolol is indicated for essential tremor, but its prescribing information lists bronchial asthma as a contraindication. The nurse should clarify the prescription before administration. Asthma does not justify independently discontinuing every beta-blocker, and the nurse should not substitute another prescription drug without an order.
